_comment: Nightly Business Central -> GL Account sync. An MJ: Scheduled Jobs record run by the APP-OWNED BizAppsAccountingBCFanOutSyncDriver (in @mj-biz-apps/accounting-server, resolved via the scheduled-job-types record). FAN-OUT: Configuration carries IntegrationID (business-central), so the driver runs one IntegrationEngine.RunSync per active, credentialed Company Integration for that integration (filter IsActive=1 AND CredentialID IS NOT NULL), with per-company failure isolation. Onboarding a new BC company is additive: create its Company Integration (+ entity/field maps) and this one job picks it up -- no new scheduled job. Kept entirely in the app repo (the stock IntegrationSyncScheduledJobDriver targets a single CompanyIntegrationID). Authored ACTIVE (Status=Active): runs nightly at 02:00 UTC. A company whose credentials aren't wired yet completes QUIETLY as Success with 0 records (missing-credential error recorded only in that run's ErrorLog). Engine computes NextRunAt from CronExpression on first poll (OwnerUserID/NextRunAt intentionally omitted -- both nullable).

fields.Name: BizApps Accounting - Nightly Business Central GL Account Sync
fields.Description: Pulls the Business Central chart of accounts into GL Accounts nightly at 02:00 UTC for ALL active, credentialed Business Central company integrations (fan-out via the app's BizAppsAccountingBCFanOutSyncDriver). Each company runs independently; a company without wired credentials completes quietly as Success with 0 records, with the missing-credential error recorded only in that run's ErrorLog (no notification).
